translated_title: Colossal Archaeological Exhibition of Mesoamerica Amazes in China

meta_description: Nearly 3,000 pre-Hispanic relics, 804 of them from Mexico, fill the Shanghai Museum in Asia's largest such show since 2001, drawing 10,000 visitors a day.
